## Paycita — Business Operations Platform

**Role:** Technical Assistant & Junior Full-Stack Developer
**Duration:** September 2026 – Present

### Overview
Paycita is a business operations platform that helps companies streamline salary payments, manage employee leave, oversee day-to-day operations, and handle procurement — all from a single system.

### What I Do
- Support the technical team in maintaining and improving the platform across payroll, leave management, procurement, and operations modules.
- Assist with front-end and back-end development tasks, including building and testing features, fixing bugs, and contributing to overall platform stability.
- Perform quality assurance checks across platform modules, verifying functionality and surfacing issues to the development team.
- Provide day-to-day technical support and documentation to help streamline internal development and operational processes.

### Tech Context
Working within a full-stack production environment, applying practical JavaScript/Node.js development skills alongside QA and technical support responsibilities.
